propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nearly identical nested pytest invocations with redundant decisions about basetemp, timeout, cache plugin and env
Three existing `--basetemp` bugs were closed as separate tickets because the duplication made them appear as three separate problems rather than one root cause

Three sites still lack `--basetemp`: test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py (executes real integration nodes), test_git_version_floor.py, and test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py (both --collect-only children)
A centralized run_nested_pytest helper must preserve caller-supplied env verbatim without merging onto os.environ to keep security-test oracles valid
The helper must forward timeout as a subprocess.run keyword, return CompletedProcess unmodified by identity, and allow TimeoutExpired to propagate
